channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Sun Tzu — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “Do not repeat the tactics which have gained you one victory, but let your methods be regulated by the infinite variety of circumstances.” — Sun Tzu

item.title: Alan Turing — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.” — Alan Turing

item.title: Guru Nanak — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “Even kings and emperors with heaps of wealth and vast dominion cannot compare with an ant filled with the love of God.” — Guru Nanak

item.title: Pema Chodron — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-10
item.description: “When you begin to touch your heart or let your heart be touched, you begin to discover that it's bottomless.” — Pema Chodron

item.title: Henry David Thoreau — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-09
item.description: “The world is but a canvas to the imagination.” — Henry David Thoreau

item.title: Ratan Tata — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-08
item.description: “The day I am not able to fly will be a sad day for me.” — Ratan Tata

item.title: Epictetus — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-07
item.description: “Control thy passions lest they take vengeance on thee.” — Epictetus

item.title: Eleanor Roosevelt — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-06
item.description: “Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.” — Eleanor Roosevelt
